correctness.rationale: For every x, the 8-leaf root oscillation after folding is the maximum of linear forms indexed by two binary sign patterns. The pair patterns reduce exhaustively to 1540 orbits under subtree swaps. Every representative has a rational feasible dual of the 63x32 integer linear program with b·y<=64 and correct free/nonnegative variable dual conditions. Exact independent Python Fraction verification passed all 1540 duals; this proves the root inequality for arbitrary real inputs, not a numerical sample. Four-atom descendant folding is covered by arxiv:2610.14459v1 Theorem 4.1. Nonnegative input attains ratio 1, and the published depth4 witness independently has exact ratio 41/40. Domain, normalization and quantifiers are explicit; no infinite-depth claim is inferred.
